scenes.label: Winter cat care
scenes.vo: Got a yard cat? They need a few winter checks too.

scenes: Somewhere draught-free they can always get to, day and night.

scenes.vo: One. A warm, dry, draught-free bed, somewhere they can always get to.

scenes: If their outdoor water freezes, keep a bowl indoors as well.

scenes.vo: Two. Water that isn't frozen. If their outdoor bowl freezes, keep one indoors as well.

scenes: Keep containers sealed. Think your cat's had some? Call your vet straight away.

scenes.vo: Three. Antifreeze is highly poisonous to cats. Keep it sealed, and if you think they've had some, call your vet straight away.

scenes: Where does your cat sleep in winter?

scenes.vo: Where does your cat sleep in winter? Tell us in the comments. And MyGroom's free, link in bio.
